source.name: Reliant press release: Reliant Stadium Returns in August 2026
source.quote: NRG Stadium and surrounding facilities at NRG Park will be renamed to Reliant Stadium and Reliant Park in August 2026, following approval by the Harris County Sports & Convention Corporation

note: Stadium naming rights: NRG Stadium renamed Reliant Stadium from August 2026; Reliant also named the stadium 2002-2014 before NRG's 2014 rebrand.
